label: Synthetic service-operations scenario; illustrative thresholds, not firm SLAs.

metric_notes.on_time_completion_rate: Completed cases completed on or before their due_at timestamp divided by all completed cases in the cohort; calendar time, not staffed-business hours.
metric_notes.first_pass_yield: Completed cases whose initial_validation is PASS divided by all completed cases in the cohort.
metric_notes.open_overdue: Open cases with due_at earlier than the report as_of timestamp.
metric_notes.aged_backlog: Open cases created more than the configured number of calendar days before as_of.
